arxiv-2212-03019.title: Style transfer and classification in hebrew news items
arxiv-2212-03019.creator: Nir Weingarten
arxiv-2212-03019.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Hebrew was classified as a Morphological Rich Language (MRL) by Tsarfaty et al. (2010). As such prefixes and suffixes are appended to words to change their grammatical meaning. This structure has been shown by Tsarfaty et al (2019) to results in inherent morphological ambiguity in the language.

arxiv-2302-02876.title: Variational Information Pursuit for Interpretable Predictions
arxiv-2302-02876.creator: Aditya Chattopadhyay, Kwan Ho Ryan Chan, Benjamin D. Haeffele, Donald Geman, René Vidal
arxiv-2302-02876.description: Abstract There is a growing interest in the machine learning community in developing predictive algorithms that are ‘‘interpretable by design”. Towards this end, recent work proposes to make interpretable decisions by sequentially asking interpretable queries about data until a prediction can be made with high confidence based on the answers obtained (the history).

arxiv-2401-01121.title: The crystalline measure that is not a Fourier Quasicrystal
arxiv-2401-01121.creator: S.Yu. Favorov
arxiv-2401-01121.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by S.Yu. Favorov. We construct a crystalline measure on the real line, which is not a Fourier Quasicrystal. AMS Mathematics Subject Classification: 52C23, 42B10

Keywords: discrete measure, Fourier transform, crystalline measure, Fourier Quasicrystal

A complex measure
\mu
with discrete support is called crystalline if
\mu
is a temperate distribution, and its Fourier transform
in sense of distributions
\hat{\mu}
is also a measure with discrete support. This measure is a Fourier Quasicrystal if the measures
|\mu|
and
|\hat{\mu}|
are also temperate distributions.

arxiv-2402-07362.title: Exploring Composite Dark Matter with an SU(4) gauge theory with 1 fermion flavor
arxiv-2402-07362.creator: LSD collaboration
arxiv-2402-07362.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by LSD collaboration. Several SU(N) gauge theories have been explored as candidates for producing stable dark matter particles that can explain their relative abundance, while also evading current constraints from direct, indirect and collider searches. In this talk, I will present the confinement and spectral properties of a new model we name "Hyper Stealth Dark Matter", which involves an SU(4) gauge theory with 1 quark flavor.

arxiv-2403-00212.title: Transcription and translation of videos using fine-tuned XLSR Wav2Vec2 on custom dataset and mBART
arxiv-2403-00212.creator: Aniket Tathe, Anand Kamble, Suyash Kumbharkar
arxiv-2403-00212.description: Abstract 1 Abstract This research addresses the challenge of training an ASR model for personalized voices with minimal data. Utilizing just 14 minutes of custom audio from a YouTube video, we employ Retrieval-Based Voice Conversion (RVC) to create a custom Common Voice 16.0 corpus. Subsequently, a Cross-lingual Self-supervised Representations (XLSR) Wav2Vec2 model is fine-tuned on this dataset.

arxiv-2410-05466.title: Herd Mentality in Augmentation - Not a Good Idea! A Robust Multi-stage Approach towards Deepfake Detection
arxiv-2410-05466.creator: Monu, Rohan Raju Dhanakshirur
arxiv-2410-05466.description: Abstract The rapid increase in deepfake technology has raised significant concerns about digital media integrity. Detecting deepfakes is crucial for safeguarding digital media. However, most standard image classifiers fail to distinguish between fake and real faces. Our analysis reveals that this failure is due to the model’s inability to explicitly focus on the artefacts typically in deepfakes.

arxiv-2506-18305.title: Existence of nuclear modifications on longitudinal-transverse structure function ratio
arxiv-2506-18305.creator: S. Kumano
arxiv-2506-18305.description: Abstract It has been assumed that nuclear modification does not exist in the longitudinal-transverse structure function ratio R N = F L N / ( 2 ​ x ​ F 1 N ) R_{N}=F_{L}^{N}/(2xF_{1}^{N}) in lepton deep inelastic scattering. This assumption is widely used in obtaining structure functions of the “nucleon” from nuclear data such as the deuteron ones.

pmc-11776081.creator: Ziyad Al-Aly
pmc-11776081.description: aise, autonomic dysfunction, and chronic conditions including new onset diabetes, cardiovascular disease, gastrointestinal and neurologic disorders.2 Long Covid can affect people across the lifespan and across age, race and ethnicity, and baseline health status.3 Chinese scientists were among the first to report Long Covid in people who survived the acute phase of Covid-19.

pmc-12587787.title: Intranasal inoculation with African swine fever virus genotype II reveals dose-dependent infectivity, pathogenesis and diagnostic challenges in pigs
pmc-12587787.creator: Adriana Muñoz-Aguilera, Sara Puente-Marin, Àlex Cobos, Cristina Riquelme, Saray Heredia, Patricia Martínez, José Ignacio Núñez, Liani Coronado, Llilianne Ganges
pmc-12587787.description: The African swine fever virus (ASFV) surveillance strategies, including the early diagnosis, are key for prevention and control of African swine fever (ASF). This work studies the effects of different doses of ASFV Georgia strain: high dose (104 HAU); moderate dose (102.5 HAU) and low dose (10 HAU), inoculated intranasally in three groups with 20 pigs each.

pmc-12653031.title: Risk of Sequelae Following COVID-19 Infection: A Nationwide Study Focusing on Risk Factors and Long-Term Impacts
pmc-12653031.creator: Simon Kjeldsen, Jan Nielsen, Bente Mertz Nørgård, Ken Lund, Pedro Póvoa, Torben Knudsen, Jens Kjeldsen, Gopalakrishnan Netuveli
pmc-12653031.description: Background/Objective: The SARS-CoV-2 pandemic, emerging in late 2019, led to a global health crisis, with many patients developing prolonged symptoms after infection known as sequelae of COVID-19. This condition is theorized to be driven by systemic inflammation and immune dysregulation and presents with diverse symptoms from cardiovascular, pulmonary, and neurological systems.

pmc-12752329.title: Radiological findings in fulminant cerebral malaria: a rare neuroimaging presentation
pmc-12752329.creator: Biswajit Nayak, Sritam Mohanty, Subhashree Das, Sagarika Panda, Shakti Bedanta Mishra
pmc-12752329.description: BackgroundCerebral malaria (CM) is a life-threatening complication of Plasmodium falciparum infection, characterized by coma, seizures, and multiorgan dysfunction. MRI findings in adult CM are underreported, particularly in cases with fulminant progression despite treatment.Case presentationA 54-year-old woman with a history of hypertension and hypothyroidism presented with fever, seizures, and altered sensorium.

pmc-12809975.title: Progressive fibrotic interstitial lung diseases in India: national challenges and implications for global health policies
pmc-12809975.creator: Satish Sasikumar, Swati Patidar
pmc-12809975.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundInterstitial lung diseases (ILDs) constitute a heterogeneous group of diffuse parenchymal lung disorders characterized by varying degrees of inflammation and fibrosis. Global estimates indicate that the incidence of ILDs has risen by over 50% in the recent years. In India, epidemiological data remain limited and inconsistent due to heterogeneity in diagnostic criteria and regional disparities, impeding accurate burden estimation and policy prioritization.Main textAmong ILDs, progressive fibrotic forms, idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) in particular, cause substantial morbidity and mortality.

pmc-12812834.title: Breaking barriers and saving lives: overcoming stigmas and enhancing childhood cancer awareness in South Africa
pmc-12812834.creator: Lauren Pretorius, Adri Ludick
pmc-12812834.description: There is a critical need for overcoming stigmas and enhancing awareness of childhood cancer in South Africa, where the underreporting and late diagnosis of cases significantly impact survival rates. Despite the global increase in childhood cancer cases, South Africa's statistics reveal a stark contrast, with only 70–80 children diagnosed per million, far below the expected incidence.

pmc-13414424.title: Revisiting the Oral–Gut Axis: Microbial Symbiosis, Dysbiosis, and Bidirectional Links Between Periodontitis and Inflammatory Bowel Disease
pmc-13414424.creator: Federica Di Gregorio, Alessandro Polizzi, Giorgia Maria Marmo, Angela Angjelova, Elena Jovanova, Roberto Campagna, Marco Mascitti, Gaetano Isola
pmc-13414424.description: Background: Recent scientific evidence indicates that the oral–gut axis represents a critical interface in host–microbiota interactions, carrying profound implications for both periodontal and gastrointestinal diseases. This scoping review aims to evaluate the reciprocal influence between periodontitis and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).
